nodes.label: Binance Proof of Reserves snapshot, 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC
Exchange futures liquidation and ADL risk

edges.claim: Binance says the snapshot was taken at 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC and updated on its PoR website; full zk-SNARK generation is pending.
Binance lists XRP among ten assets it says are fully backed at 100%; exact XRP units and independent proof remain pending.
Binance says the remaining 10% consists of less-liquid tokens outside the ten named assets, not XRP among the named fully backed assets.
Binance says partial SAFU deployment is expected within 24 hours and that SAFU will be replenished to approximately USD 1 billion.
Binance says a portion of its Futures Insurance Fund was used and the remaining balance is above its internal required risk level; exact balance is unknown.
Binance says corporate treasury contributed to replenishment; token-specific allocation is undisclosed.
Reuters reports Coinbase said it adjusted systems that store cryptocurrency keys offline as a precaution; exact changes and XRP-specific effects are unknown.
Alpha Finance reports USD 8.4 million net inflow for the October 29 session and USD 1.73 billion cumulative net inflow since November 14, 2025; holdings/AUM are not published in this series.
Binance describes the fund as a liquidation-deficit/ADL safety net and says the remaining balance remains above required levels; the independent buffer size is unknown.

hypotheses.statement: Binance's October 31 00:00 UTC snapshot restored XRP customer-custody coverage to at least 1:1.
disconfirming_evidence: The full zero-knowledge proof was not available at capture.
No independent address-to-customer-liability recomputation was completed.
The statement does not disclose exact XRP reserve and liability units.
next_tests: Download the October 31 reserve address list and user-liability proof; reconcile all XRP reserve addresses and customer net balances at the same cutoff.

hypotheses.statement: Binance's recovery created material new XRP spot or OTC demand.
disconfirming_evidence: No XRP-specific quantity, USD amount, trade, OTC confirmation or funding-source split is disclosed.
The company may have used existing company inventory or internal transfers.
next_tests: Crosswalk source and reserve addresses, then reconcile timestamped exchange/OTC disclosures and post-snapshot reserve changes.

hypotheses.statement: Reallocation of a portion of the Futures Insurance Fund could reduce derivatives loss-absorption capacity.
disconfirming_evidence: Binance says the remaining fund exceeds its required risk level and that the released amount was excess.
No public fund balance or independent stress test was obtained.
next_tests: Capture the public daily insurance-fund balance and compare against historical liquidation/ADL stress periods.

hypotheses.statement: The Binance incident is accelerating exchange custody-control changes and information-sharing proposals.
disconfirming_evidence: Reuters does not disclose the exact Coinbase control changes or demonstrate a measurable reduction in custody risk.
next_tests: Track official Coinbase security disclosures and independently documented control changes.

entity_separation: Native XRP is not an issuer-controlled stablecoin and cannot be frozen by an XRP issuer.
RLUSD, USDC and USDT are issuer-controlled stablecoins with distinct freeze authorities and chain-specific contract behavior.
Binance customer-custody reserves, SAFU, Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury are separate pools; do not aggregate them as one reserve balance.
Coinbase's offline-key adjustments are custody-security controls, not evidence of a new XRP market position.
